description: This file declares the MediaKeysCapabilities class and the MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory class, which are part of the Rialto media server implementation. It defines interfaces for media key capabilities, including supported key systems and version retrieval, and includes dependencies on other media and CDM interface headers.

classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysCapabilities.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements the IMediaKeysCapabilities interface, providing media key support details.
